title: Lithic hero
description: A big black panel with 24px corners, inset from the window edge, holding a centred two-line 64px headline in white, a 24px lead and two pills (glassy and orange) side by side; stacked full-width on phones. The artwork behind is a soft bronze-wash placeholder with faint contour rings.
notes: the panel always reads the theme's .dark colours, so it stays dark in light mode
media fills the whole panel behind the type (object-fit: cover)
on a page whose own background is black (dark mode), the panel has no visible edge
name: lithic-hero

props.name: media
props.description: the artwork behind the type, covering the panel. A placeholder when empty
